audit_sources.summary: Product Fitness work was still being wired through schemas, red fixtures, package inventory, and claim guards; the signal was that documentation-only Product Fitness was not enough.
The orchestrator was correcting stale proof, syncing installed and cache package version 0.0.10, and repairing red catalog/schema bookkeeping drift.
A proof blocker remained around live_registry_exposure and whether it was bounded reviewer-registry provenance or an overclaim of live app/marketplace proof.
The user typed the missing Chronicle/session-log audit request while the review packet lane was already active.
The packet lane produced source/install/cache evidence and a detached packet, but it completed without a session-log issue inventory.
A hostile review found same-version non-cache installed root drift: installed audit had stale digest and lower red fixture count while source/cache were current.
The packet run loaded repo context and later wrote review-packet-current.json, but the session-log audit request was not implemented as a repo-owned finding inventory.
The user added that this plugin must audit typed parsing boundaries, exact 100% coverage, and line-cap adherence because it is not exempt from Harness Ultragoal laws.
The packet summary recorded strict claim ceilings and no current live registry receipt, but remained outside the validator and did not include issue dispositions from session logs.

findings.observed_gap: The packet was created as a detached evidence bundle before the required June 25 Chronicle/session-log audit was turned into an issue inventory.
findings.affected_surface: review packet, validator provenance, package inventory
findings.required_repair: Add a repo-owned session-log hardening receipt, schema, validator check, package inventory entries, and successor packet that records implemented findings and blockers.
findings.claim_ceiling_impact: Reviewer-ready claims now depend on this receipt and cannot be inferred from a detached packet alone.

findings.observed_gap: A stale June 21 active-registry exposure receipt and local disk install/cache proof could be confused with current app registry, chooser, marketplace, or reviewer exposure proof.
findings.affected_surface: active registry, material review, review packet claim ceiling
findings.required_repair: Require this hardening receipt and successor packet to declare active_registry_current_proof as not_produced and keep live registry/reviewer readiness out of the supported claim ceiling.
findings.claim_ceiling_impact: No live active-registry, Plugins UI, marketplace, install-button, launcher runtime, or current reviewer-exposure claim is supported.

findings.observed_gap: Earlier same-version installed root proof had stale digest and fixture counts, so version 0.0.10 alone was not enough to prove source/install/cache alignment.
findings.affected_surface: source package, non-cache installed plugin, versioned cache package
findings.required_repair: Refresh installed and cache copies from the same candidate archive, rerun same-surface audits, and include digest evidence in packet/successor packet.
findings.claim_ceiling_impact: Local installed/cache same-digest proof is supported only for the regenerated same-candidate audit receipts, not for older same-version receipts.

findings.observed_gap: Product Fitness began as an added law and plan surface and needed enforcement against documentation-only proof and substitution claims.
findings.affected_surface: Product Fitness schema, receipt, substitutions, validator
findings.required_repair: Keep product-fitness-proof bound to schema validation, receipt digest/evidence checks, and substitution rejection checks.
findings.claim_ceiling_impact: The proposal supports package/static Product Fitness gate enforcement, not real user Product Fitness or daily-driver success.

findings.observed_gap: Red catalog and generated schema bookkeeping drift changed expected fixture counts during the day.
findings.affected_surface: validator receipt, red fixture report, schema catalog
findings.required_repair: Use current validator receipts with package digest, red fixture count, red report, and package inventory closure instead of stale counts.
findings.claim_ceiling_impact: Only regenerated 458-red-fixture receipts can support the current June 25 candidate.

findings.observed_gap: The review-round validator correctly treats live_registry_exposure as same-round reviewer-spawn provenance, but that proof does not become app registry or marketplace proof.
findings.affected_surface: review-round receipts, reviewer materiality, registry preflight
findings.required_repair: Continue enforcing same-round exposure/session matching in review-round receipts and keep stronger app-registry claims out of the packet.
findings.claim_ceiling_impact: Material review sign-off remains unsupported without fresh same-round reviewer exposure and live reviewer outputs.

findings.observed_gap: Session evidence repeatedly called out standards enforcement rows and zero-evidence red fixture work as proof-bearing, not prose-only.
findings.affected_surface: agent standards enforcement, standards gardening, red fixtures
findings.required_repair: Keep standards rows under validator-backed agent-standards-enforcement and standards-gardener-promotion checks.
findings.claim_ceiling_impact: Standards rows can support package/static enforcement only where validator checks bind them.

findings.observed_gap: The plugin itself needed a current check that parsing and typed boundaries are real, not merely taught to generated target repos.
findings.affected_surface: validator JSON boundary, schema catalog, typed semantic receipt loaders
findings.required_repair: Run the validator unit suite and package audit through json_boundary/schema_catalog paths; keep JSON parsing, schema resolution, path containment, symlink, hardlink, and typed receipt checks in validator-owned code.
findings.claim_ceiling_impact: Typed-boundary enforcement is supported for the validator surfaces covered by current tests and audit receipts, not for untested runtime surfaces.

findings.observed_gap: The repo has no root .harness/coverage-command, and live cargo llvm-cov proof failed the 100% line coverage gate at 6.68% line coverage.
findings.affected_surface: validator source coverage, completion/readiness/material sign-off claim ceiling
findings.required_repair: Do not claim complete, ready, release-ready, material sign-off, or 100% coverage until a typed coverage receipt proves coverage.percent = 100 with uncovered_records = [].
findings.claim_ceiling_impact: No 100% coverage, complete, ready, release, production, phase advancement, or material sign-off claim is supported.

findings.observed_gap: The plugin source needed a current line-cap check against the active Rust migration hard cap of 250 lines unless generated or explicitly justified.
findings.required_repair: Run validator/src line counts and keep changed source files under 250 lines; current audit found no validator/src .rs file over 250 lines.
findings.claim_ceiling_impact: Line-cap adherence is supported for validator/src Rust source in this candidate; it does not replace coverage or live registry proof.

current_claim_ceiling: Supports source package/static/fixture enforcement and current multi_agent_v1 reviewer-agent registry exposure only. Does not support live app registry, Plugins UI, marketplace, install-button, launcher runtime, current reviewer exposure beyond multi_agent_v1 tool registry, material review sign-off, real user product fitness, daily-driver success, and does not support 100% coverage until the current coverage receipt reaches exact 100% with no uncovered records.
